description:
Remember the pattern. Prepare the rocket. Reach space.

Space IQ is a NASA-inspired memory puzzle game built with Unreal Engine 5. Players become astronauts and complete visual and auditory pattern challenges to prepare a rocket’s fuel, navigation, and life-support systems. Complete every challenge, board the rocket, and launch into space to win.

summary:
MISSION RECALL — Explore. Survive. Return

MISSION RECALL is an immersive 3D space exploration and survival game that challenges players to experience the dangers and excitement of a lunar mission.

The story follows Pilot Sleepy and a second astronaut whose spacecraft suffers a critical malfunction near the Moon, forcing an emergency landing. Stranded on the lunar surface, players must explore unfamiliar terrain, navigate low-gravity environments, operate futuristic lunar vehicles, collect essential resources, and work together to repair their spacecraft.

Developed using C++, raylib, and OpenGL, the project aims to combine realistic space environments, interactive gameplay, and educational concepts inspired by real space exploration.

**Our mission is simple: Explore the Moon, overcome the impossible, and find a way home.**
details:
MISSION RECALL — An Interactive Lunar Survival Experience

Project Overview

MISSION RECALL is a 3D lunar exploration game designed to introduce players to the challenges of space missions through immersive storytelling, scientific concepts, and interactive gameplay.

The game begins when a spacecraft approaching the Moon experiences a sudden technical failure. Emergency sirens activate, onboard systems malfunction, and Pilot Sleepy must take control to execute an emergency landing.

After reaching the lunar surface, the astronauts discover that their spacecraft requires repairs before they can return home.

Key Features

1. Realistic Space Mission Simulation

Players experience an emergency spacecraft landing with interactive flight controls, warning systems, and lunar descent mechanics.

2. Open-World Moon Exploration

Explore a detailed lunar environment featuring craters, mountains, rocky landscapes, and scientific exploration locations.

3. Low-Gravity Movement

Experience Moon-inspired gravitational physics, allowing astronauts to perform extended jumps, move across challenging terrain, and use jetpacks.

4. Two-Player Cooperative Gameplay

Control two astronauts who must coordinate their actions, explore the environment, collect resources, and complete mission objectives together.

5. Futuristic Lunar Vehicles

Operate a large exploration vehicle designed to transport astronauts across difficult lunar terrain.

6. Mission-Based Survival Challenges

Complete tasks involving spacecraft repairs, resource management, scientific exploration, and navigation.

Technology

  • Programming Language: C++17
  • Development Environment: Visual Studio 2026
  • Graphics: OpenGL
  • Game Framework: raylib
  • Build System: CMake
  • 3D Assets: Blender, GLB, glTF, and FBX models
  • Platform: Windows PC

Educational Purpose

MISSION RECALL aims to introduce players to important space exploration concepts, including lunar gravity, spacecraft landing, astronaut mobility, resource limitations, and teamwork.

By transforming scientific challenges into interactive missions, the game encourages problem-solving, creativity, and interest in space technology.

Future Vision

The long-term vision is to expand MISSION RECALL into a more advanced space exploration experience featuring larger lunar environments, additional missions, improved spacecraft systems, and enhanced cooperative gameplay.

Conclusion

MISSION RECALL combines science, technology, creativity, and interactive entertainment to inspire the next generation of space explorers.

MISSION RECALL — Explore. Survive. Return.

Created by: Moiz

Event: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — Jeddah
